itemUsage.en: Aegir native Clemenceau, pleased to meet you.
itemUsage.zh: 阿戈尔人克莱门莎，很高兴见到你。

itemDesc.en: Depending on context, "pleased" can refer to the profound significance of sea-land cooperation, or it can genuinely just mean "pleased."
itemDesc.zh: 取决于语境，“很高兴”的意思可以是海陆合作的一系列重要意义，也可以真的只是“很高兴”。

description.en: Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>, and each attack deals Physical damage equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@aoe_atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK to the target and up to <@ba.vup>5</> nearby ground enemies; summons a floating exile pod ahead that causes up to <@ba.vup>15</> nearby ground enemies with a total weight of no more than <@ba.vup>{attack@max_passenger_mass}</> to continuously Move forward; the exile pod disappears after moving 3 tiles and leaves behind a whirlpool; all enemies within the whirlpool have their Movement Speed reduced by <@ba.vup>{attack@move_speed:0%}</> and take <@ba.vup>200</> <$ba.dt.erosion2>Corrosion</> and Physical damage equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@physical_atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK per second
description.zh: 攻击范围<@ba.vup>扩大</>，攻击速度<@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>，每次攻击对目标及其周围最多<@ba.vup>5</>名地面敌人造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@aoe_atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害；向前方召唤浮游放逐舱，放逐舱使周围累计不超过<@ba.vup>{attack@max_passenger_mass}</>重量的最多<@ba.vup>15</>名地面敌人不断向前移动；放逐舱在移动3格后消失并留下漩涡，处于漩涡的所有敌人移动速度<@ba.vup>{attack@move_speed:0%}</>且每秒受到<@ba.vup>200</>点<$ba.dt.erosion2>侵蚀损伤</>和相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@physical_atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害

description.en: Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, targets <@ba.vup>+2</> enemies, each attack deals Physical damage equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK to the targets, and inflicts additional <$ba.dt.erosion2>Corrosion</> equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@ep_damage_ratio:0%}</> of the Physical damage dealt; when an enemy on the battlefield has an outburst of <$ba.dt.erosion2>Corrosion</>, consumes 1 ammo to deal <@ba.vup>3</> instances of Physical damage equal to <@ba.vup>{s3_atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK and Elemental damage equal to <@ba.vup>{ep_damage_scale:0%}</> of ATK to all ground enemies at the target's position and the four surrounding tiles\n<@ba.rem>Loaded with {trigger_time} ammo; skill ends when all ammo is spent (can be manually deactivated at any time)</>
description.zh: 攻击范围<@ba.vup>扩大</>，攻击目标数<@ba.vup>+2</>，每次攻击对目标造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害并额外造成相当于物理伤害<@ba.vup>{attack@ep_damage_ratio:0%}</>的<$ba.dt.erosion2>侵蚀损伤</>；当全场有敌人<$ba.dt.erosion2>侵蚀损伤</>爆发时，消耗1发弹药对目标所在位置及其周围四格内所有地面敌人造成<@ba.vup>3</>次相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{s3_atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害与相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{ep_damage_scale:0%}</>的元素伤害\n<@ba.rem>技能装有{trigger_time}发弹药，打完后结束（可随时停止技能）</>
